card.title: How to fix an iPad Air that shows the low battery screen but will not charge

source.title: How to fix an iPad Air that shows the low battery screen but will not charge

symptoms: low battery screen but will not charge

claims.statement: An iPad Air that shows the low-battery screen on the charger but never charges and goes blank when unplugged most commonly needs a new battery.

procedure: Replace the battery and retest charging.
card.caveats: Short page; rule out the charge port first. Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
